rn.intro: Your ministers report actual developments and submit further proposals when action is still needed.
rn.stimme.fortschritt: “We are making progress. The measured value has improved, but it has not reached the relief threshold.”
rn.stimme.rueckschlag: “The situation has worsened since my previous measurement. We need a substantive response.”
rn.stimme.unveraendert: “There is no clear recovery yet. The change is below one point; the problem remains unresolved.”
rn.stimme.entspannt: “The measurement is now within the relief range. I will check in 14 days whether this holds.”
rn.stimme.stabilisiert: “Two consecutive reports are within the relief range. I will keep monitoring and report again in 30 days.”
rn.stimme.rueckfall: “The relief did not hold. The measurement is back in the critical range.”
rn.schritt.beobachten: Monitoring continues. The political assessment below shows the reactions actually recorded.
rn.schritt.anliegen: A concrete ministry request awaits your decision. Check costs, majority and consequences in the response preview.
rn.schritt.bearbeitung: A proceeding or assignment is already underway in the ministry. This counts as work in progress, not proven recovery; measurements continue.
rn.schritt.verantwortung: A new ministry incident still needs your political response. The measurement imposes no second penalty.
rn.schritt.warteschlange: Three requests are already open. Please answer them first; the minister will come back at the next report.
rn.wechsel: Since the previous measurement, {neu} has taken over from {alt}. The values describe the same ministry, not one individual’s performance.
rn.altstand: For this earlier decision, measurements begin on {datum}. No recovery is claimed for the earlier period.
rn.erste: Baseline for {groesse}: {wert}. A personnel decision alone does not prove recovery.
rn.unbesetzt: The office is currently vacant. A new officeholder is needed for personal reports; the substantive problem remains.
rn.anliegen.beauftragt: proposal initiated; effect still to be measured
rn.anliegen.erledigt: request addressed or situation eased; consult measurements
rn.anliegen.archiv: no longer in the current request list
rn.regel: Reports every 14 days; every 30 days after two measurements without critical ministry indicators. Relief: at most 62 for harmful indicators, at least 38 for beneficial ones. Changes of at least one point count as progress or setback.
rn.grenze: Measured development since your decision, not an isolated causal estimate. Budgets, laws, minister performance and other crises act at the same time. Reporting itself heals nothing and fulfils no promise.
rn.historisch: Saved state for this month. Later actions, measurements and officeholder changes do not alter this report.
rn.abgeloest: A later minister decision started a new observation.
rn.naechsteHistorisch: Next report scheduled at the time: {datum}.
rn.stimme.teilErholt: “The original problem has eased. Other ministry indicators remain critical; I cannot give an overall all-clear yet.”
